## Purpose of This Page

This page defines the foundation of our career-evaluation product. It explains who the product is designed for, what career question it will answer, and why pharmaceutical manufacturing is a relevant industry for analytics careers.
:::

## 7. Expected Dataset Fields

<!-- SECTION OWNER: Partner 1 -->
<!-- INSTRUCTIONS: Review the MET Employability Career Match dataset and confirm which available fields will support the analysis. -->

| Field or Variable | How the Team Expects to Use It |
|---|---|
| Industry or NAICS code | Filter postings to pharmaceutical and medicine manufacturing |
| Job title | Identify positions within the selected analytics career family |
| Salary | Compare compensation across relevant positions |
| Experience | Evaluate experience requirements and role attainability |
| Location | Identify geographic concentrations of opportunity |
| Remote-work status | Compare remote, hybrid, and onsite opportunities |
| Skills | Identify demanded tools, technologies, and qualifications |
| Education | Evaluate degree and education expectations |
| Employer | Compare hiring activity across organizations |
| Other field | *Add another relevant field if available* |

## 9. Project Scope and Boundaries

<!-- SECTION OWNER: Jenna -->
<!-- INSTRUCTIONS: Review and revise the included and excluded project boundaries. -->

### Included

- Job postings connected to the selected career pathway
- Pharmaceutical and medicine manufacturing under NAICS 3254
- Relevant skills, experience, salary, geography, and work arrangements
- Career-readiness recommendations for the target user

### Not Included

- The entire labor market
- Careers unrelated to the selected pathway
- Industries outside the selected industry scope unless needed for context
- Claims that cannot be supported by the available data
